# Vendored libraries

- `jsQR.js` — [jsQR](https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR) v1.4.0, Apache-2.0 license.
  QR code decoding fallback for browsers without the native `BarcodeDetector` API.
- `qrcode.js` — [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) v1.4.4, MIT license.
  QR code generation for the QR Maker tool.
- `pdf-lib.min.js` — [pdf-lib](https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib) v1.17.1, MIT license.
  Client-side PDF merge/split/sign; lazy-loaded when the PDF tool opens.
